games.title: Sony Indefinitely Delays Another PS5 Peripheral Days Before Release
games.summary: Desktop speakers switched off for now. Sony has indefinitely delayed the PS5’s official Pulse Elevate desktop speakers, which were originally due to deploy days from now, on 12th November. In a brief update on the PS Blog , the manufacturer said that it had “identified a production issue with the product and have made the decision to delay the launch”.
